'''Gunner''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who participated in the [[Battle of Bogoa]] under command of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. Gunner was injured during the fight, but he was saved by a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] named [[Coppertop]].

==Biography==
Developed from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Clone Databank" /> the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who would take on the name Gunner was created to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], Gunner served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]. At some point during the war, Gunner was part of a [[Company/Legends|company]] sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]] to fight off the Separatist's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Good Clanker" />

The [[Battle of Bogoa|battle]] lasted three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and during the fight Gunner encountered the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] bounty hunter [[Cyreltov]] and sustained injuries. After the battle ended, the injured Gunner laid on the ground and was eventually found by [[Coppertop]], a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who attempted to aid the injured clone. Coppertop bandaged Gunner and the two were eventually found by Commander Cody who had been searching the battlefield for survivors. Cody was about to blast Coppertop before Obi-Wan Kenobi stopped him, realizing that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had saved Gunner's life. Coppertop explained to them that on the second day of the conflict, he heard a voice whisper the words "[[Order 99]]" to him, which caused his primary systems to shut down and upon rebooting was left with the core command to ignore his programming.<ref name="Good Clanker" />

With Coppertop joining them, Cody carried Gunner back to the group of clones who had survived the battle. Joined with the group, Gunner laid on ground until the Separatist [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and bounty hunter Cyreltov made arrived as they were after Coppertop. Upon seeing the bounty hunter, Gunner drew his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and attempted to inform General Kenobi on who the Chiss was. A fight then ensued and only ceased when Coppertop surrendered over to the Separatists.<ref name="Good Clanker" />

==Personality and traits==
Gunner was a clone of Jango Fett, and as such stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin. Gunner had light brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] which he shaved into the [[double stripe]] hairstyle.<ref name="Good Clanker" />

==Equipment==
Gunner wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] with a [[Kama/Legends|kama]] and [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Glove/Legends|gloves]]. He was armed with a blaster pistol.<ref name="Good Clanker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gunner appeared in ''[[The Only Good Clanker]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic strip]] written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by artist [[Will Sliney]], which was included in the [[October]] [[2011]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.26|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.26]]''. There is one panel in the comic where one of Gunner's gloves is shown to be the same color as his skin while the other is gray, instead of the orange seen throughout the rest of the comic. There is also a panel where Gunner's hair is black, rather than the light brown color seen in the other comic panels.<ref name="Good Clanker" />
